Tesseract.js OCR, served from this site so ID checks work without a third-party CDN.
- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
- tesseract-core-*.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
- lang/eng.traineddata: @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int model (Apache-2.0), stored uncompressed
